CRAS: hfp_slc - Fix codec negotiation We're seeing peripheral not sending reply to +BCS command until specific other AT command is sent and handled. To make sure codec negotiation is reliable, check and resend +BCS command after any other AT command is handled. This patch also increase the timeout to 500ms for when SLC established until codec negotiation is completed. This helps to ensure codec negotiation has completed when BT audio option becomes available to user. And it only affects the case when codec negotiation never completes(for whatever reason) by introducing delay to when user sees BT audio option show up on UI. vm_tools: Make X sommelier scale internal displays differently X11 applications historically use DPI to decide their scaling, however this does not work for laptops, which are closer to you and so usually have a higher DPI. To solve this problem, the X server usually lies about the DPI of laptops. We emulate this behaviour for chromeos by applying a scale factor if the display is the internal one. We choose 0.66 semi-arbitrarily (based on measuring sample laptop/desktop screen distances in our office). Whilst this fixes some devices, it breaks others, base on a pre-existing bug in sommelier where it would choose a DPI bucket that is no higher than the true DPI. E.g. the pixelbook2's DPI of 232 would be rounded to 160 (not 240) which looks correct, because we werent applying the laptop-distance scale, whereas another device's 168 DPI would be rounded to 160, which looks unusually big (96 would be better), because we werent applying the laptop-distance factor which means the "ideal" DPI for that device is actually 112, closer to 96. hwid: Remove chassis from default encoding and increase RO EC field length The 'chassis' was introduced after Reef (multi-OEM zerg) and before Unibuild (Coral). It had few assumptions that are no longer true today, for example: - `chassis` was designed to support multiple projects (zerg or WL) in a single HWID database file, but follower units are now always identified as new 'model' today which has its own HWID database file. - Since Unibuild, the 'chassis' is always reported as model name. - Since Unibuild, white label units share same chassis name. So what it served was replaced by either model name or SKU information. Given all newer projects will only do Unibuild, we should release the 5 bits for better usage. In the meantime, we previously allocated 3 bits for AP RO firmware, and 2 for EC RO. These were not sufficient because devices may have 2~3 unsupported RO (EVT, DVT, PVT) and 2~3 times of refresh, so in the end we often see devices increasing fields for these, making it harder to search and maintain, for example counting EC RO field length: nocturne(3), shyvana(3), grabbiter(3), sand(6), apel(3), eve(6), atlas(6), dumo(4), robo(4), wukong(7), ..... So let's try to make it default to 5 bits now. Note that dram, ap/ec RO fw version and fw key fields have moved to different location. Devices with existing HWID database file do not need to change anything. This is simply changing the default new file created by HWID database builder.
